scenicChapters.title: Kazakhstan Charyn and Kolsai Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 26 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

kazakhstan-charyn-and-kolsai-route.story: A one-way ride of 446 km, Almaty to the finish - roughly 6 h 22 in the saddle. It goes by way of Kolsai Lakes, Saty and Charyn Canyon. The highest point is about 2,750 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

legend-alpujarras-mountain-road.slogan: Alpujarras Mountain Road – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-alpujarras-mountain-road.story: curated scenic road. Sierra Nevada, white villages, high pass. A one-way ride of 100 km, Granada to Guadix - roughly 1 h 49 in the saddle. It goes by way of Lanjarón, Pampaneira, Trevélez and Aldeire. The highest point is about 2,050 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Alpujarras Mountain Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 23 km this is Alpujarras Mountain Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
